name: astramai
description: AstraMai —— 面向小米 Vela 端的街机音游工具（落雪查分器对接）基础工程与 Web 测试站

scripts.build: npm run build -w @astramai/core && npm run bundle:core && npm run build -w @astramai/server && npm run build -w @astramai/web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @astramai/core && npm run test -w @astramai/server && npm --prefix apps/vela test
scripts.site:deploy: node apps/site/build.mjs && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/site/dist --project-name astramai-site --branch main
